rubric.description: (a) Class header declares `CheckingAccount extends Account` and has instance variables for the fee and the withdrawal count
(a) Constructor calls `super(initial)` and initializes the fee (and the count)
(a) Overrides `withdraw` with the same signature (`public boolean withdraw(double amt)`)
(a) Decides success using `amt + fee` and removes `amt + fee` from the balance (for example with `super.withdraw(amt + fee)`) without accessing `balance` directly
(a) Increments the withdrawal count only on a successful withdrawal and returns the correct boolean; `getWithdrawals` returns the count
(b) Traverses all accounts and calls `withdraw(amt)` on each one (no type tests or casts needed)
(b) Counts the successful withdrawals and returns the count
(a) Class header declares `Perishable extends Item` and declares an instance variable for the days left
(a) Constructor calls `super(name, price)` and initializes the days left
(a) `getPrice` overrides with the same signature and returns half the regular price when `daysLeft <= 2`
(a) `getPrice` otherwise returns the regular price, obtained with `super.getPrice()` (no direct access to the private field)
(a) `toString` overrides and uses `super.toString()` followed by the days left in the required format
(b) Traverses the list and compares prices using `getPrice()` (not a field), so discounts apply
(b) Keeps track of the item (not just the price) with the lowest price, keeps the first on ties, and returns it
